article.story: HOUSTON -- — Jakevion Buckley scored 25 points to lead Southeast Louisiana to a 69-60 victory over Houston Christian on Monday night. Buckley also grabbed seven rebounds for the Lions (16-9, 10-4 Southland Conference). Sam Hines Jr. had 12 points and Brody Rowbury scored 11. Julian Mackey finished with 25 points and two steals for the Huskies (11-14, 8-6). Bryson Dawkins had 12 points and D'Aundre Samuels totaled 10 points, seven rebounds, four assists and three blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
